attributes.cause: tools/project.py declares download_tool output=binutils directory, not each executable. configure.py incorrectly added the objcopy executable as an implicit input in both atree postprocess branches. A warm checkout hid the missing build edge.
attributes.sibling_screen: rg -n 'atree_objcopy|binutils|globalize_atree' configure.py tools/project.py identifies both atree call sites and the GNU assembler path. The assembler already uses binutils_implicit or gnu_as, precisely the distinction adopted here. Both atree branches are repaired and covered. Executable command path is unchanged; no scope expansion into compiler download or postprocessor proof logic.
attributes.symptom: python tools/gdl/provision_worktree.py from a newly created isolated worktree failed after configure with: ninja: error: 'build/binutils/powerpc-eabi-objcopy.exe', needed by 'build/GUNE5D/src/game/anim/atree.o', missing and no known rule to make it. Its retry reproduced the same failure. The one-file copy used to unblock provisioning was diagnostic only, not the delivered solution.
attributes.verification: python -m unittest tools.gdl.tests.test_r74_atree_bootstrap -b passes. The test executes the actual configure block for both modes and Windows/Linux names, custom tool paths, and a miniature real Ninja graph: old dependency refuses with missing-and-no-known-rule, repaired dependency schedules download and export. Live test moved this lane's binutils aside recoverably, regenerated configure and ran ninja -j2 build/GUNE5D/src/game/anim/atree.o: TOOL build/binutils downloaded the archive and WEBFRANK+EXPORT completed. Subsequent ninja -j2 and dtk shasum -c config/GUNE5D/build.sha1 print build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK.

subject: tool:atree-exports
value: The atree exporter now waits on the managed binutils download OUTPUT (build/binutils), while a user-supplied --binutils path still depends on its objcopy executable. This repairs cold builds in both matching and editable configuration branches without changing exporter behavior or compiled bytes.
